title: fix(approvals)!: an approver reassigns only their own slot
body:

Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the reassign door's `from`; the approvals guide already lists reassign as the pending approver handing over a slot, which is now the enforced rule

## 维护者速读

- 审批人在多审批人的审批步骤上改派时,只能把自己的那一席交给别人;管理员和系统的改派不变,普通用户在界面上看不到差别。
- 为审批流程的职责分离加固,由安全席位派发。
- 出错的话,某位审批人改派自己那一席会被拒绝;改动只有一处判断,可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

An approver reassigns only their own slot. On `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/reassign` (and `IApprovalService.reassign`), a caller that is neither the system nor an administrator acting through the approval override may name as `from` only a slot it acts under: its user id, its account's email, or a position it holds — the same address set the slot test already reads. Any other `from` is refused with the existing refusal shape, `403 FORBIDDEN`, and nothing moves. Omitting `from` still hands over the caller's own slot. The administrator override, the administrator rescue of a slate that names no one, and the system are unchanged.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` — `reassign()`: one guard in the hand-off branch, after the platform-slot check.
- `.changeset/sec2-48g2.md` — `patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, BREAKING for the narrowed caller, ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

2. `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-reassign-own-slot.dogfood.test.ts` — the door pins.
